scope: Real Editor Play Update/native ParticleSystem/Destroy. All 120 profiles run once in batches <=16. CPU phases use the same representative at 1 and 16 instances, with three zero-effect baselines. CPU markers include Editor/engine work and harness overhead; deltas are estimates, not isolated VFX method timings, GPU measurements or frame-rate-goal PASS.
limitations: No forced GC or UnloadUnusedAssets; dynamic Editor resources created by other windows can confound material/mesh growth. No visual, build, damage/target timing or 30/60/120 deterministic PASS. Spawn warmup is excluded from CPU samples; steady update/render/native particle cost is included. Native particles are read during lifetime tests, not during CPU samples.
